verdict.rationale: Asking whether a government filing service publishes its source code under an open license is a fair question, since agencies can and do open-source their software, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public source repository or an open license for USPTO's systems. The API, developer-portal and form-preview items are adjacent and do not cover source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
